2607.13920.title: DeepStress: Stress-Testing Deep Search Agents
2607.13920.paper_summary: While search agents demonstrate impressive capabilities in multi-step question answering, their robustness to poor-quality evidence remains under-explored. This phenomenon occurs rarely in realistic benchmarks but can lead to dramatic failure in real life applications. Therefore in this study we propose DeepStress, a stress testing framework that controls the frequency of challenging evidence by replacing the retrieval module of search agents with a controlled synthetic environment. We use this framework to control three dimensions that can affect document reliability: trustworthiness, relevance, and factuality. Testing several search agents on HotpotQA and BrowseCompPlus, we demonstrate that agents exhibit substantial differences in their ability to handle unreliable information and propose new metrics that better document systems outcomes as well as the interactions between conflicting parametric and retrieved knowledge.
2607.13920.paper_summary_zh: 雖然搜尋代理在多步驟問題回答中展現出令人印象深刻的能力，但它們對於低品質證據的穩健性仍然未被充分探討。這一現象在現實基準中很少發生，但在實際應用中可能導致劇烈的失敗。因此，在本研究中，我們提出了DeepStress，一個壓力測試框架，通過用受控的合成環境替換搜尋代理的檢索模塊來控制挑戰性證據的頻率。我們使用這個框架來控制三個可能影響文件可靠性的維度：可信度、相關性和事實性。在HotpotQA和BrowseCompPlus上測試幾個搜尋代理，我們展示了代理在處理不可靠信息的能力上存在顯著差異，並提出了新的指標，以更好地記錄系統結果以及衝突的參數知識和檢索知識之間的互動。
